name: Call Method
description: Calls a bundle outside this canvas: stdlib, a module, or hand-written CFEngine.

parameters.name: bundle_name
parameters.label: Bundle name
parameters.help: A bundle that already exists elsewhere — CFEngine's standard library, a cfbs module, or one you wrote by hand — e.g. "my_bundle" (looked up in the default namespace) or "ns:my_bundle". Canvas blocks call each other automatically; this isn't for that.

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.label: Arguments
parameters.help: One per line, in the bundle's parameter order. $(…) passes a variable's value, @(…) a list.
